text:
Estimated portions before eating:
- Spaghetti with meat sauce: about 350 g, roughly 550 kcal.
- Roast chicken (a drumstick plus a few slices of breast): about 150 g with skin, roughly 280 kcal.
- Fruit bowl (watermelon, apple, melon): about 150 g, roughly 60 kcal.
- Greek salad with feta and olives: about 200 g, roughly 180 kcal.
- Juice: about 250 g, roughly 110 kcal. The drink is probably not counted as food, but its energy is included here.
- Dressing bottle (balsamic/oil): about 40 g, roughly 120 kcal. It looks mostly used, since the bottle is nearly empty afterward and the salad seems undressed.

Estimated leftovers after eating:
- Spaghetti: about 40 g left, so about 310 g eaten, roughly 485 kcal.
- Chicken: the drumstick bone with some meat and a piece of breast remain, so about 60 g eaten of 150 g, roughly 110 kcal. The chicken was probably skin-on and the skin appears eaten.
- Fruit: about 80% of the fruit is still in the bowl in the second photo, so about 30 g eaten, roughly 12 kcal.
- Salad: about 40% eaten, so about 80 g, roughly 70 kcal.
- Juice: about 40% left, so about 150 g drunk, roughly 65 kcal.
- Dressing: about 25 g used, roughly 70 kcal.

Totals eaten: kcal ≈ 485 + 110 + 12 + 70 + 65 + 70 ≈ 812, rounded to about 800. Mass ≈ 310 + 60 + 30 + 80 + 150 + 25 = 655 g.
